style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, no drawn overlays
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window and crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY window, talking ones too, always SIDEWAYS, NEVER toward or away from the lens; he never hovers, drifts or talks sitting still: every move starts by shoving off glass, gravel or furniture; legs in shot, nothing between him and the lens, never facing the lens while talking; new shot size every window; the last frame still moves
character: a glossy red lobster in a black tailcoat, a monocle, ONE huge claw and one small
second_characters: TWO CRABS in bow ties, waiters inside the tank
props: a blank cream price tag on a string on his small claw; a red velvet rope; a velvet stool
prop_continuity: the tag stays on him to the last frame; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: inside a wide glass tank on a marble table in a rich salon, gilt frames and chandeliers blurred beyond the glass, guests clinking out there; gravel floor, a gravel slope, a velvet stool in the tank; HE stays in the tank the whole time
lighting: bright chandelier light through the water, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, calm and unhurried, even 4.3 syllables per second
audio.pacing: speech 0.7-2.5 and 2.9-7.9; voiceless outside, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open on every syllable
audio.sfx: muffled clinking beyond the glass, water surging, gravel scattering, claws knocking glass, a rope whipping

timeline.a: silent. THE LOBSTER shoves off the glass at top speed and rakes the tank left to right past the lens, gravel bursting behind him, A CRAB spun around in his wake
THE LOBSTER slams the far glass, kicks off it and tears back right to left along the bottom
THE LOBSTER cartwheels claw over tail edge to edge across the gravel, THE CRAB ducking flat under him
THE LOBSTER hits the stool, springs off its velvet seat and slings himself along the gravel
THE LOBSTER throws himself on his back and skids the whole width of the tank on his shell, all legs pedalling
still on his shell THE LOBSTER whips his tail and shoots back the other way under the stool
THE LOBSTER flips upright, rams the gravel slope and climbs it the whole frame height
THE LOBSTER launches off the slope and sails edge to edge over both CRABS
THE LOBSTER punches the gravel and rebounds bottom of frame to top
THE LOBSTER tears along the glass right at the lens, the tag snapping behind him
THE LOBSTER kicks the glass and drives edge to edge, then kicks the far wall and drives straight back
THE LOBSTER rams the stool and shoves it across the tank, A CRAB scrambling off the seat
THE LOBSTER hurls himself up the glass from the bottom of frame to the top, gravel raining off him
THE LOBSTER drops astride the stool and throws the big claw up in a museum pose, THE CRABS whipping the velvet rope across the tank, the rope still swinging

must_appear: the tag on him throughout, gravel flying every window, both crabs, tailcoat and monocle, the rope across the tank at 10.0
negative_prompt: speech bubble, comic balloon, cyrillic, subtitles, watermark, blood, gore, night, dark scene, a still camera, a hovering hero, a hero talking while still, macro on a small prop, human hands in the tank, a frozen final frame, slow motion, any word after 7.9, silence in the tail
